event.description: Train shared width 15 with corrected shifted teacher forcing
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 14 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0022 at width 10 under an older topology; the most recent failed result is attempt-0031, an execution error before optimization because fresh training forwarded 33 tokens after the model's exact maximum had become 32. The traceback was inspected and classified as a pipeline shape defect, not model evidence. Hypothesis: with intended shifted teacher forcing now forwarding the 32 input tokens and predicting the 32 following targets, the fully shared width-15 model can co-adapt and qualify at 2,096 parameters. This repaired executable test is more informative than the nearest untested width 14 because width 15 is the exact capacity boundary and attempt-0031 produced no accuracy observation.
